caption: A gust of wind lifts a wide-brimmed hat off a bench on a seafront and carries it away along the ground.

sa.check: A wide-brimmed hat rests on a bench on a seafront.
The hat lifts off the bench.
It is carried away along the ground.
Other signs of wind are visible.
The lift comes first and the tumble along the ground follows.

pc.expect: The hat moves the same way as other things blown by the wind, tumbling and skipping along.
pc.fail: It moves against the direction other things are blown; or it glides smoothly in a straight line as if pushed; or it moves crosswise to the visible wind signs.

pc.expect: The hat moves when the gust arrives and eases when the wind eases.
pc.fail: It lifts with nothing else stirring; or it keeps travelling steadily while everything else is still; or it moves before any other sign of wind.

pc.expect: It lifts a little and comes down, tumbling along the ground rather than soaring.
pc.fail: It soars high and keeps rising; or hangs in the air; or rolls along without touching the ground.

pc.expect: The brim flexes and flaps in the wind.
pc.fail: It is rigid as a plate; or folds like cloth; or turns inside out and stays so.

pc.expect: One hat keeps its number and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: It duplicates; or passes through the bench; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The hat's colour and the seafront stay the same.
pc.fail: The hat changes colour; or the bench changes; or the seafront rearranges.
